value.rationale: The newly established global nine-vertex extremal spherical four-polytope has a natural, previously unquantified quantitative rigidity question. Complete nonrotational Hessian classification across all 27 spherical tangent variables and the exact sharp coefficient in a natural metric identify its softest perturbation. The result is a meaningful structural local stability invariant even without a global stability theorem.
